publicDefinition: baseGameMultiplier/respinFeature are filtered; ticket and weight fields omitted; uncertainty flags retained. Completed outcome frames remain past-state only.
presentation: Base grid animates first; conditional multiplier is displayed only from confirmed outcome.
Completed nullable respin frames replay in order; selected/wild positions stay locked; no blank placeholder is replaced by a fake symbol.
Top factor distinguishes selected feature multiplier from multiplier actually applied to the current board.
STOP cancels all pending presentation and reveals the unchanged final completed frame and canonical total result once.
No animation callback emits a wager or settlement action.
limitations: Provider private probabilities, exact media/audio and complete visual equivalence remain unverified.
Respin preview contract currently follows Tiger semantics; other feature families need explicit matching contracts before reuse.
This work did not connect or mutate production wallets, deploy or push.
